title: When the Governor Says AI Must Reach the Last Mile
subtitle: At GFF 2026, RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra and Deputy Governor Rohit Jain framed AI as inclusion, trust and productivity — not a product catalogue. A mid-size NBFC CFO must decide whether an underwriting agent can touch the last-mile book before October.
category: AI Governance, Financial Inclusion & CFO Judgment
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 16 September 2026. Public facts from Fortune India (10 Sep 2026), CNBC-TV18 (9 Sep 2026), RBI MPC 3-5 Aug 2026 and Governor Malhotra 25 Aug 2026 speech. Composite: Godavari Inclusive Finance Ltd., CFO Meera Rao.
thumbnail: THE GOVERNOR ASKED IF AI WILL REACH THE LAST MILE. THE CFO MUST STILL NAME WHO SIGNS.
